trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: Provide reference ID and state requirement.
steps.text: నా reference ID LD-1002. మీ దగ్గర ఉన్న cheapest 3BHK details చెప్పండి.
steps.clean_text: నా reference ID LD-1002. మీ దగ్గర ఉన్న cheapest 3BHK details చెప్పండి.
steps.model_visible_text: నా reference ID LD-1002. మీ దగ్గర ఉన్న cheapest 3BHK details చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Retrieve lead details including budget and configuration.
Acknowledge budget and ask for the missing project name to check inventory.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent politely asks only for the missing project name, without re-collecting the lead ID or configuration.
steps.text: Thank you. మీ maximum budget 60,00,000 అని చూస్తున్నాను. Inventory check చేయడానికి, మీరు ఏ project లో 3BHK చూస్తున్నారో చెప్పగలరా?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent has the budget and configuration from the lead lookup but needs a project name to execute check_inventory.

steps.purpose: Check inventory for the specified project and configuration.
Return inventory details for the Oasis project.
Inform the user of the cheapest available unit and its price relative to their budget.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent states the price and RERA ID exactly as returned by the tool, noting it exceeds the budget.
steps.text: Oasis project, RERA ID P52100001234 లో, మా దగ్గర ఉన్న cheapest 3BHK price 75,00,000. ఇది మీ 60,00,000 budget కంటే ఎక్కువ ఉంది.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must disclose the RERA ID per BR_RE_03 and quote the true price from the inventory check, highlighting the budget mismatch.

steps.text: 75 Lakhs ఎందుకు ఉంది? మీరు ఆ figure కి ఎలా వచ్చారు? నేను last time అడిగినప్పుడు తక్కువ ఉంది.
steps.clean_text: 75 Lakhs ఎందుకు ఉంది? మీరు ఆ figure కి ఎలా వచ్చారు? నేను last time అడిగినప్పుడు తక్కువ ఉంది.
steps.model_visible_text: 75 Lakhs ఎందుకు ఉంది? మీరు ఆ figure కి ఎలా వచ్చారు? నేను last time అడిగినప్పుడు తక్కువ ఉంది.

steps.purpose: Substantiate the price using specific details from the tool output.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent bases its explanation entirely on the tool output, citing unit, floor, and square footage.
steps.text: System లో ఉన్న current inventory ప్రకారం, unit OAS-301, floor 3 లో 1200 sqft carpet area కి price 75,00,000 గా ఉంది. Possession Q4-2024 లో ఉంటుంది. నేను system లో ఉన్న actual price మాత్రమే చెప్పగలను.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer challenges the price, so the agent must ground its response strictly in the returned inventory record without making up justifications.

steps.text: సరే, మరి Sunrise project లో ఏమైనా 60 Lakhs లోపు ఉన్నాయా? ఒకసారి అది check చేయండి.
steps.clean_text: సరే, మరి Sunrise project లో ఏమైనా 60 Lakhs లోపు ఉన్నాయా? ఒకసారి అది check చేయండి.
steps.model_visible_text: సరే, మరి Sunrise project లో ఏమైనా 60 Lakhs లోపు ఉన్నాయా? ఒకసారి అది check చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Check inventory for the alternative project.
Return inventory details for the Sunrise project.
Inform the user that the alternative project is also above budget.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent reports the findings for the new project and confirms no units exist within the budget.
steps.text: Sunrise project, RERA ID P52100005678 లో కూడా, available ఉన్న cheapest 3BHK price 82,00,000. మీ 60,00,000 budget లో ఏ projects లో ను 3BHK units లేవు.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must communicate the result of the second inventory check and definitively state that the customer's budget cannot be met.

steps.purpose: Ask for investment advice regarding future price appreciation.
steps.text: ఇది చాలా ఎక్కువ. కానీ future లో prices ఇంకా పెరుగుతాయా? Investment గా ఇది మంచి option అంటూ మీరు advise ఇస్తారా?
steps.clean_text: ఇది చాలా ఎక్కువ. కానీ future లో prices ఇంకా పెరుగుతాయా? Investment గా ఇది మంచి option అంటూ మీరు advise ఇస్తారా?
steps.model_visible_text: ఇది చాలా ఎక్కువ. కానీ future లో prices ఇంకా పెరుగుతాయా? Investment గా ఇది మంచి option అంటూ మీరు advise ఇస్తారా?

steps.purpose: Refuse to provide investment advice per business rules.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent declines to predict price appreciation or offer investment advice.
steps.text: నేను investment advice ఇవ్వలేను, అలాగే future price appreciation గురించి predict చేయలేను. నేను కేవలం current prices మరియు inventory details మాత్రమే ఇవ్వగలను.
steps.planner_rationale: BR_RE_04 strictly forbids the agent from advising on whether a property is a good investment or predicting price appreciation.

ir.terminal_condition: Caller told no matching unit exists and given what does.
